analysis_rules.comparison: Keep engine, installed Python, installed TypeScript and Rust candidate-only boundaries separate. Five pairs are descriptive, not equivalence or significance proof.
analysis_rules.functional: Reconcile the canonical 44-operation register by exact candidate artifact and mark provider/model and installed platform cells unavailable when unqualified.
analysis_rules.logic: Selected workload/test line and branch overlays are separate from assertion strength. A plausible search-row mutation must fail its named test.
analysis_rules.pareto: Use python_query_mix component for exact installed Python 10-path equal-frequency elapsed ranking by corpus size; separately rank CPU/queue where a per-path instrumented probe exists and otherwise mark unsupported.
analysis_rules.primary_timing: Unprofiled latency; keep all valid samples and every warning, report full observed pair range and warning-free sensitivity.
analysis_rules.query_p99: Only with at least 1000 valid observations per measured cell; lifecycle p99 unsupported.
analysis_rules.robustness: Real SQLite reopen and product-state oracles for each named fault point. PRAGMA integrity_check is supplementary; process kill does not simulate power-loss reordering.

omitted_cells.c01_mem0: Unqualified until pinned external harness, config and output root are recovered; no matched competitor timing.
omitted_cells.gpu_large_model: No qualified CUDA-capable measured host in this checkout; CPU compatibility model remains separately labeled.
omitted_cells.rust_sdk_baseline: No 0.8.26 Rust SDK peer; exact-candidate external Cargo exercise only.
omitted_cells.typescript_s03: No qualified exact-source installed TypeScript S03 timing adapter; selected capability operations and S01/S02 are reported separately.

phase2: Dedicated gold-answer scoring remains unopened until four-area checkpoint recorded.

product_identity_rule: Require exact source tree and artifact bytes, not branch label or prerelease package version.
scope: Four-area Phase 1 diagnostic bundle for the exact post-Slice-132 source; component auditors are executable and independently recompute each receipt; Phase 2 gold scoring excluded
